services: Escrow services for business sales and business-related assets.
Commercial real estate escrow and real property escrow coordination.
Attorney-focused escrow services, including holding and disbursement accounts, settlement escrows, and litigation escrows.
Account servicing and customized escrow services for complex transactions.
UCC, tax lien, judgment, and county/Secretary of State searches.
audiences: Lenders, borrowers, and parties needing neutral third-party funds or asset administration.
service_area: Official FAQ says some matters may be handled nationally or internationally.
confirmed_facts.hours: Public business hours were not found on the official pages reviewed; confirm directly before publishing hours.
differentiators: Official site describes the company as Arizona's largest independent escrow company.
Official site says principals and staff have served business community escrow needs since 1976.
Provides a fraud prevention center and account servicing portals.
trust_signals: Official website lists direct phone, fax, and info@arizonaescrow.com.
Official rate schedule is published online.
Local record is backed by the Greater Phoenix Chamber directory source_url.
pricing_notes: Fees & Rates page lists business and personal property escrow fees starting at $1,000 for gross value up to $20,000, effective 04/01/2025.
Real property escrow fees start at $800 for gross value up to $100,000, with additional fees for values over $500,000.
UCC search fees are listed at $50 per name for Secretary of State and county searches.
The official rates page says charges may be revised for unusual complexity or additional work and all fees are subject to revision without notice.
Call for a quote on services not listed.
